name: Escapement
author: Trance
description: A watch movement drawn in pencil. The balance swings and its hairspring breathes, and every swing lets the escape wheel slip one tooth: the voices and the bite of the snares set the pace. Behind it, faint, the same movement under the watchmaker's loupe.
frame:
ph = ph + dt*(1.2 + 2.5*min(presence_att, 2))
tooth = floor(ph)
swing = sin(ph*pi)
esc = -(tooth + smoothstep(0, 0.2, fract(ph)))*tau/15

layers.point:
th = t*tau
rr = 0.26 + 0.055*fract(t*15)
x = 0.42*aspect + rr*cos(th + esc)
y = rr*sin(th + esc)

k = floor(t*3)
u = fract(t*3)*2 - 1
an = 0.9*swing + k*pi/3
x = -0.32*aspect + 0.36*u*cos(an)
y = 0.36*u*sin(an)
a = step(0.03, fract(t*3))*step(fract(t*3), 0.97)

rr = (0.015 + 0.13*t)*(1 + 0.12*swing*t)
th = t*tau*7 + 0.9*swing
x = -0.32*aspect + rr*cos(th)
y = rr*sin(th)
